Dedicated to Professor Yingbo Zhang on the occasion of her 80th birthday
metadata.abstract: LetH n(u) be the degenerate cyclotomic Hecke algebra with parameteru={u 1, . . . , um}. The paper aims to define and construct the (non-)normalized Markov traces on the sequence{Hn(u)}∞ n=1. This allows us to provide the Brou´ e–Malle–Michel symmetrizing trace onH n(u) and show that the Brundan–Kleshchev trace is a specialization of the non-normalized Markov traces onH n(u). 1.Introduction Letm,nbe positive integers and letW m,n be the complex reflection group of typeG(m,1,n) in Shephard–Todd’s classification [22]. It is well-known thatW m,n is isomorphic to the wreath product (Z/mZ)n ⋊Sn, whereS n is the symmetric group of degreen(generated by the simple transpositions si = (i,i+ 1) fori= 1,...,n−1). Letu={u 1,...,u m}be a set of indeterminates and letC(u) be the fraction field ofC[u]. The (generic) degenerate cyclotomic Hecke algebraH n(u) is the unitary associative algebra overC(u) gen- erated byt,s 1,...,s n−1 and subjected to relations: (t−u 1)...(t−u m) = 0, t(s1ts1 +s 1) = (s1ts1 +s 1)t, tsi =s itfor 1≤i≤n−1, s2 i = 1 for 1≤i≤n−1, sisi+1si =s i+1sisi+1 for 1≤i≤n−2, sisj =s jsi for|i−j|≥2. It is known thatH n(u) is free as aC(u)-module of rank|W m,n|=m nn! and is a deformation ofW m,n (see [16,§7]). Let us remark that the degenerate cyclotomic Hecke algebras are degenerate versions of the Ariki– Koike algebras or the cyclotomic Hecke algebra of typeG(m,1,n), which originates from the works of Drinfel’d [7] and Cherednik [6] and was mentioned explicitly in Grojnowski’s preprint [11], Kleshchev’s book [16] would be a good reference. These two classes of algebras are closely related, as evidenced by Brundan and Kleshchev’s seminal work [4], which shows that both algebras are isomorphic to a cyclotomic Khovanov–Lauda–Rouquier (KLR) algebra where the weight is determined by the “cyclotomic parameters”.
